paths.result: Catalogue/application metadata is reusable under the Toronto Open Government Licence, but this source does not expose the AIC supporting-document attachment corpus.

paths.path: City Clerk Public Notices open data and background notice artifacts
paths.result: 1126 planning notices were linked to 1465 canonical properties through exact application numbers. Notice text is contextual evidence only.

paths.path: Active and cleared building permits open data
paths.result: Permit records are a lawful addressable enrichment source, but they are not copies of AIC mechanical drawings, schedules, energy, planning, or acoustic reports.
Meeting reports and attachments can support selected application review, but no complete deterministic AIC attachment mirror was identified.
The current public application search remains usable by a reviewer; automated attachments remain reCAPTCHA-gated and were not bypassed.

public_notice_results.identity_limitation: Only exact public-notice application numbers already joined through the deterministic AIC property spine are linked; no text/address fuzzy match is used.

evidence_contract: Public notices, permits, and meeting materials do not become confirmed cooling-tower evidence. No result here is represented as the unavailable AIC supporting-document corpus.
